Enabled.title: Sanity Enabled
Enabled.description: Enable/disable Sanity integration for the store

ProjectId.title: Project ID
ProjectId.description: Sanity project ID for Content API access

ApiToken.title: API Token
ApiToken.description: Sanity API token for Content API authentication; also the default token for projects without their own token in the Projects setting

DocumentTypes.title: Document Types
DocumentTypes.description: Comma-separated list of Sanity document types to fetch and index (default: page). Example: page,siteSettings,footerNavigation

PageType.title: Page Type (legacy)
PageType.description: Legacy single Sanity document type to index as pages. Superseded by Document Types

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: JSON array describing all Sanity sources of the store. Entry fields: projectId (required), apiToken (optional, falls back to the API Token setting), datasets — a map of dataset name to its document types as a comma-separated string or an array (empty inherits the Document Types setting), dataset — single dataset name used when datasets is omitted (default: production), priorityDataset — the dataset that wins when the same document exists in several datasets (conflicts are logged). When empty, the single project from the Project ID, Dataset, and Document Types settings is used. Example: [ { "projectId": "abc12345", "apiToken": "sk...", "datasets": { "production": "page,footerNavigation", "marketing": ["landing", "blog"] }, "priorityDataset": "production" }, { "projectId": "xyz67890", "datasets": { "content": "landing" } } ]
